items.headline: Brandon High Jr. scores go-ahead TD with 14 seconds left and UTSA beats Texas State 31-26
items.description: — Brandon High Jr. ran for a go-ahead 25-yard touchdown with 14 seconds left, and UTSA beat Texas State 31-26 on Saturday for the 100th win in program history.
